data.title: 02 · 海风里的彩色糖果
data.description: 【海边旧码头·正午】02穿着红白泳装盘腿坐在旧码头边，手里抓着一串彩色糖果；她用脚尖踢起水花，粉发被风吹得乱七八糟，转头朝镜头做出得意鬼脸，像把整个夏天都占为己有。
data.action: 旧码头边踢水花吃彩色糖果，迎风乱发后对镜头做得意鬼脸
data.lighting: crisp noon light with turquoise reflections
data.mood: 把夏日当成私人舞台的活力少女
data.promptProse: Zero Two from DARLING in the FRANXX wears a red-and-white sailor swimsuit with a loose white overshirt, striped socks and a candy pouch. She sits cross-legged on the old pier with a bright candy pouch in her lap, flicking seawater with one bare foot. Her long pink hair and white headband whip in the breeze as she makes a triumphant face at the viewer, turning a quiet dock into her private summer stage. crisp noon light with turquoise reflections.
